question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        sr.id as sales_rep_id,
        sr.name as sales_rep_name,
        r.name as region,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as rep_total_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name, r.name
),
region_order_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name as region,
        COUNT(o.id) as order_count,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as total_sales_amount
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name
),
max_sales_per_region AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        MAX(rep_total_sales) as max_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.region,
        rs.sales_rep_name,
        rs.rep_total_sales
    FROM rep_sales rs
    JOIN max_sales_per_region msp ON rs.region = msp.region 
        AND rs.rep_total_sales = msp.max_sales
)
SELECT 
    rot.region,
    rot.order_count,
    rot.total_sales_amount,
    tr.sales_rep_name,
    tr.rep_total_sales
FROM region_order_totals rot
JOIN top_reps tr ON rot.region = tr.region
ORDER BY rot.region, tr.sales_rep_name

        sr.name as sales_rep_name,
        r.name as region,

    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name, r.name
),
region_order_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name as region,
        COUNT(o.id) as order_count,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as total_sales_amount
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name
),
max_sales_per_region AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        MAX(rep_total_sales) as max_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.region,
        rs.sales_rep_name,
        rs.rep_total_sales
    FROM rep_sales rs
    JOIN max_sales_per_region msp ON rs.region = msp.region 
        AND rs.rep_total_sales = msp.max_sales
)
SELECT 
    rot.region,
    rot.order_count,
    rot.total_sales_amount,
    tr.sales_rep_name,
    tr.rep_total_sales
FROM region_order_totals rot
JOIN top_reps tr ON rot.region = tr.region
ORDER BY rot.region, tr.sales_rep_name
